{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness browser visualization plugin: a visible Chrome window per session, 16 chrome_* agent tools, live view in the Web GUI. 浏览器可视化插件：每会话一个可见 Chrome 窗口，16 个 chrome_* 工具与实时画面。","id":"gh:1340893040","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-chrome","slug":"jiaererw/dsh-plugin-chrome","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness browser visualization plugin: a visible Chrome window per session, 16 chrome_* agen"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"t tools, live view in the Web GUI. 浏览器可视化插件：每会话一个可见 Chrome 窗口，16 个 chrome_* 工具与实时画面。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-chrome"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A DeepSeek Harness browser visualization plugin: opens a **real, visible Chrome window** per sessi"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"on, lets the agent drive the browser through the `chrome_*` tool suite, and streams the **live view*"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"* into a Chrome tab in the Web GUI — take over manually at any time."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Features
- Install
- Usage
- Configuration
- FAQ
- Development
- License"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **A visible window per session**: every DSH session gets its own Chrome window (a real window, not"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" headless). Watch every agent action as it happens; the window uses an isolated user-data-dir, so it"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" never mixes with your daily browser.
- **Live view**: the Chrome tab in the Web GUI streams the win"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"dow through Chrome screencast (smooth while pages are active). A screenshot heartbeat keeps idle pag"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"es from freezing — a forced frame about every 2 seconds once the stream has been silent for 3 second"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"s.
- **Complete agent tool suite** (16 tools): `chrome_open` / `chrome_status` / `chrome_close` / `c"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"hrome_navigate` / `chrome_tabs` / `chrome_snapshot` / `chrome_screenshot` / `chrome_click` / `chrome"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"_click_at` / `chrome_fill` / `chrome_type` / `chrome_press_key` / `chrome_hover` / `chrome_scroll` /"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" `chrome_evaluate` / `chrome_wait`. `chrome_tabs` covers list / new / close / select, and snapshots,"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" screenshots and clicks always act on the selected tab.
- **Accessibility-tree snapshots**: `chrome_"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"snapshot` returns a compact a11y tree with stable element uids; clicks and fills target uids directl"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"y — far lighter than DOM dumps and robust against fragile selectors.
- **Dual-channel screenshots**:"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" `chrome_screenshot` sends the image into the model context (as an image block) AND saves it to the "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"session's screenshot history shown in the panel — history entries keep title/URL/size metadata acros"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"s restarts. (Running a text-only model? See the FAQ.)
- **Security-minded**: CDP never exposes a fix"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"ed port; the Web API rejects cross-site requests (Sec-Fetch-Site) and whitelist-validates sessionId;"},{"id":"p8s17","text":" browser data is isolated per session.
- **Resource governance**: idle windows auto-close (default 1"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"0 min, configurable), `chrome_close` closes explicitly, and plugin unload / host shutdown closes eve"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"ry window it opened."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Prerequisites: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) installed, and Chrome or Edge on the machine."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart DSH after installing — a **Chrome** tab appears at the top of every conversation."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` still carries an old manual mount line for `dsh-plugin-chrome"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"` (from local development), remove it before installing through the CLI to avoid double-mounting."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### For the agent (tools)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The agent gets the `chrome_*` suite automatically. Just ask it:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> Open Chrome, go to https://example.com, take a screenshot, then click the "Login" button and fill "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"o to https://example.com, take a screenshot, then click the "Login" button and fill in the username."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The agent will: `chrome_open` → `chrome_navigate` → `chrome_screenshot` (sees the image) → `chrome_s"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"napshot` (gets uids) → `chrome_click` / `chrome_fill`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### For you (visualization)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Open the **Chrome** tab at the top of the conversation:
- **Live view**: continuously shows the w"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"indow. Native screencast frames flow while the page changes; a heartbeat fallback force-captures idl"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"e pages (about one frame every 2 seconds) so the picture never freezes.
- **Tab management**: create"},{"id":"p20s4","text":", switch or close tabs from the side list, in sync with the real window.
- **Manual takeover**: clic"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"k around in the Chrome window yourself at any time — the agent sees your changes on its next tool ca"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ll.
2. **Screenshot history**: every `chrome_screenshot` is stored in the panel; click a thumbnail t"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"creenshot history**: every `chrome_screenshot` is stored in the panel; click a thumbnail to enlarge."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Window lifecycle & resilience"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Lazy start**: Chrome launches only on the first `chrome_*` call (or the panel's Open button).
- "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"**Orphan adoption**: if DSH died and left a Chrome behind (profile locked), the plugin reconnects th"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"rough `DevToolsActivePort` and takes the window over instead of failing (the same autoConnect idea a"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"s chrome-devtools-mcp).
- **Idle reaping**: a window idle past `idleTimeoutMs` (default 10 min) clos"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"es automatically — never while a Web UI viewer is watching.
- **Auto tab recovery**: every operation"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" makes sure a usable tab exists, so a window full of `chrome://` internal pages never dead-ends."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Override the plugin row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (config is replaced wholesale):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Data directory (browser profiles & screenshots): `~/.dsh/data/dsh-plugin-chrome/sessions/<sessionId>"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"/` (override with `dataRoot`)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## FAQ"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **The Chrome tab shows nothing**: check the window is running (status dot at the top); the first l"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"aunch takes a few seconds. Idle pages get a forced frame about every 2 seconds via the heartbeat (af"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ter 3 seconds without a real frame); activity raises the frame rate automatically.
- **Agent says "u"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"nknown uid"**: the page changed — have it re-run `chrome_snapshot`.
- **I closed the window myself**"},{"id":"p28s5","text":": the panel shows "window closed"; any next `chrome_*` call or the Open button relaunches it.
- **Lo"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"gin state**: each session uses an isolated profile, so logins don't carry over from your daily brows"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"er — that's by design. To log in somewhere, let the agent complete the login (it persists for the se"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"ssion).
- **Chrome stays open after DSH is killed**: the orphan window is adopted on the next sessio"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"n call (or close it by hand); a clean DSH shutdown closes its windows.
- **Screenshots stop a text-o"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"nly model from responding**: `chrome_screenshot` delivers the picture as an image block into the con"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"versation history. If the session's model does not accept images, every following turn is rejected w"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"ith `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: does not accept image input` and the session no longer responds — retrying"},{"id":"p28s13","text":" doesn't help. Use a vision-capable model for sessions that screenshot, or avoid `chrome_screenshot`"},{"id":"p28s14","text":" there.
- **Install blocked by pnpm (strict-dep-builds)**: add `dsh-plugin-chrome: true` to `allowBu"},{"id":"p28s15","text":"ilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and retry the install."}],"truncated":true}
